item.title: Patch: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition: OS Command Injection
item.description:
EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition: RCE · low-privileged account · local access · exploited · fix: Ver8.00 Update 5, Ver3.10, Ver7.00 Update 6

First step: Update EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition to the fixed version for your release line (for example Ver8.00 Update 5, Ver3.10 or Ver7.00 Update 6).

EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

High · Fix available · CVE-2026-106931
